name: A long turn that says it did the hard part makes Boop proud
case: Boop has been following the agent's work (engaged) when it spends a few minutes on a tricky migration and finishes, saying everything is moved over and working. Boop is proud of the work: its mood turns proud, with a proud or happy face, played as a success.
why: characters/boop/steering/mood/engaged.md: engaged leaves for proud when a long turn ends with the agent saying the hard work is done and working; react.animation: a turn done whose last message says it works is a success

steps.message: Done: the migration is written and applied, every user row moved over, and the full test suite passes.
